name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: The best cross-department improvement is to standardize a single "ready-for-transcription" checklist across Creative and Operations. Creative will tag videos as ready only when the checklist is complete; Operations will reject any submission missing items. This eliminates rework from mismatched expectations and speeds up the pipeline. The trade-off is that Creative must slow down to fill the checklist, but the net gain in throughput justifies it.

name: Scriv
text: The risk: a rigid checklist will slow down Creative’s nimble workflow and create a new bottleneck where none exists today. A better alternative is to let Creative mark videos “ready” and have Operations run a lightweight, automated pre-check that flags missing items without blocking submission—this keeps quality without adding friction. Settle it by running a two-week pilot: Creative uses the checklist, Operations logs rework rates, and we compare to the current baseline.
